metros.label: Metro Chicago
metros.boundary_note: Before the 2023 delineation this CBSA was Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN-WI and included Kenosha County, WI (55059). Kenosha is excluded here for every year so the geography is constant over time.

metros.label: Greater Cleveland
metros.boundary_note: Under the 2013-2020 delineations this CBSA was Cleveland-Elyria, OH and excluded Ashtabula County (39007). Ashtabula is included here for every year so the geography is constant over time.
